# Colossal Cave binary provenance

`Adventur.com` and `Phrogz.din` are the unchanged files from
[Advent_CPM.zip](https://www.ifarchive.org/if-archive/games/cpm/Advent_CPM.zip),
listed in the [IF Archive CP/M directory](https://www.ifarchive.org/indexes/if-archive/games/cpm/).
The [Interactive Fiction Technology Foundation](https://iftechfoundation.org/)
is linked here for source attribution; its distribution rights for these files
have not been independently verified.

The executable contains this notice, retained verbatim in its bytes:

> COPYRIGHT (C) 1977 SMALL SYSTEM SERVICES, INC. URBANA ILL. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED

The supplied archive was reported to contain no licence. On 12 September 2026,
John Hardy authorised proceeding with distribution from the IF Archive source,
with attribution and links, while deferring further rights investigation. This
records that project decision; it is not a new licence or a claim that the
original rights holder granted permission.

[manifest.json](manifest.json) records the source archive digest supplied with
the handoff, the individually verified binary digests and the immutable r1
image digest. The executable version has not been established beyond this exact
binary identity. Triptych changes only the filenames to uppercase during disk
import; it does not patch either binary or insert this notice into the image.

The original preparation files remain outside this checkout. Repository-owned
inputs make subsequent image builds independent of that private workspace or
any browser's saved disks. [The sample guide](../../samples/colossal-cave/README.md)
describes the tested profile and core-image save procedure.
